Name: Hoham, King of Hebron
Summary: Hoham was king of Hebron and one of the five kings who allied against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua.
KeyStory: Hoham joined Adoni-zedek against Gibeon, fled to the cave at Makkedah, and was hanged with the other four kings.
LifeLesson: Alliances against God end in the same cave.
